scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional Brownian diffusion with nonzero drift, nonnegative independent proportional Poisson resets, and gamma targets at the excursion exponential scales. Classical beta-gamma identities supply some steps; historical priority against unlocated abstract perpetuity theorems is provisional. Finite tests supplement rather than replace proof.
title: Skew-gamma rigidity for drifted Brownian diffusion with random proportional resets
